enforcement.mechanism: parent polls /proc/<pid>/status VmHWM (peak RSS), the growing artifact size, and free disk while the child runs; SIGKILL on breach
enforcement.rss_enforced: per-record rss_enforced flag; true only when /proc sampling succeeded
enforcement.output_budget_live: polls the final artifact and its <path>.tmp sibling each interval, then re-checks after child exit before accepted/readback; bounded overshoot is one poll interval of growth during the run, and the post-exit check bounds the final artifact exactly
enforcement.atomic_publish_aware: sibling <path>.tmp is guarded and cleaned up; original rc kept separate from the budget verdict

sample.criteria: size deciles by rank (seeded picks) + largest tail; read-back complex classes computed post-measure
sample.justification: Bounded deterministic sample: per-decile seeded picks cover the size distribution, the largest tail drives the wall/RSS/disk bound. Structural classes are derived post-measure from ready metadata (read-back counts), not from a new parser.

run.disk_note: Each artifact is written to tmp_dir and deleted immediately after read-back; no persistent cleaned layer remains. Disk accounting is statvfs before/after.

measured: export wall time and peak RSS (per file)
output artifact bytes and output/input ratio
read-back records/segments density per input KiB
structural_coverage.note: No product surface exposes per-document depth or table counts without new XML parsing, which this harness deliberately does not add. Depth/table heaviness is represented by read-back segment/record density and input size.

readback_disclaimer: Read-back (cleaned-project read) is a counts-only re-read of the artifact produced by this same process. It is NOT an independent substrate verify; substrate independence is cleaned-project verify against the frozen source package and is out of scope here.
non_claims: Not a full-corpus run: a bounded stratified sample only.
Not semantic acceptance: resource measurement only.
Read-back is not an independent substrate verify.
No raw decoded text in evidence; paths/counts/hashes only.
Feasibility conclusions from this sample are conditional extrapolations (T03).
